```{python}
# ── Error-type constants ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

DEFAULT_BASES = ("A", "C", "G", "T")
LEGACY_BASES = ("A", "C", "G", "T", "N")
ERROR_LABELS = (
    "match",
    "sub_to_A", "sub_to_C", "sub_to_G", "sub_to_T",
    "ins_A", "ins_C", "ins_G", "ins_T",
    "deletion",
)
_ERROR_GROUP: dict[str, str] = {
    "match": "match",
    "sub_to_A": "substitution", "sub_to_C": "substitution",
    "sub_to_G": "substitution", "sub_to_T": "substitution",
    "ins_A": "insertion", "ins_C": "insertion",
    "ins_G": "insertion", "ins_T": "insertion",
    "deletion": "deletion",
}
_GROUP_COLORS = {"match": "#4477AA", "substitution": "#EE6677",
                 "insertion": "#228833", "deletion": "#CCBB44"}
_BASE_COLORS = {"A": "#4477AA", "C": "#EE6677", "G": "#228833", "T": "#CCBB44", "N": "#AA3377"}


def _error_type_group(error_type: str) -> str:
    return _ERROR_GROUP.get(error_type, "other")
```

## Parameter Category Registry

The `PARAMETER_CATEGORIES` list defines the axes along which model parameters are
coloured in the per-model volcano plots. Each entry maps a display label to a
column that must exist (or be derived) in the parameter rows DataFrame.

**To add a new category for a future model type** (e.g. homopolymer run length,
latent state), append a new `ParameterCategory` to this list and populate the
corresponding column in the extraction functions below.

```{python}
@dataclass
class ParameterCategory:
    """Specification for one colour dimension in a parameter volcano plot.

    Attributes:
        key: Internal identifier used to match columns in the DataFrame.
        label: Short name shown in the dropdown button.
        column: Column name expected in the parameter DataFrame.
        description: Sentence shown as the plot subtitle when this category
            is active. Helps readers interpret the colouring.
        colors: Ordered colour sequence; values cycle if there are more unique
            category levels than colours.
    """

    key: str
    label: str
    column: str
    description: str
    colors: list[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: list(px.colors.qualitative.Plotly))


PARAMETER_CATEGORIES: list[ParameterCategory] = [
    ParameterCategory(
        key="error_type_group",
        label="Error group",
        column="error_type_group",
        description="Grouped error class: match / substitution / insertion / deletion",
        colors=list(_GROUP_COLORS.values()),
    ),
    ParameterCategory(
        key="error_type",
        label="Error type (detailed)",
        column="error_type",
        description="All 10 error categories including each substitution and insertion direction",
    ),
    ParameterCategory(
        key="nearest_base",
        label="Nearest preceding base",
        column="nearest_base",
        description="The immediately preceding consensus base (rightmost context character)",
        colors=[_BASE_COLORS.get(b, "#888888") for b in ("A", "C", "G", "T", "N")],
    ),
    ParameterCategory(
        key="context_distance",
        label="Context distance",
        column="context_distance",
        description=(
            "Distance of the influencing base from the current position "
            "(1 = immediately preceding; only available for position-decomposed parameters)"
        ),
    ),
    ParameterCategory(
        key="context_base",
        label="Context base",
        column="context_base",
        description="Which nucleotide occupies the influencing position",
        colors=[_BASE_COLORS.get(b, "#888888") for b in ("A", "C", "G", "T", "N")],
    ),
    # ── Future categories — uncomment and implement extraction when available ──
    # ParameterCategory(
    #     key="homopolymer_feature",
    #     label="Homopolymer feature",
    #     column="homopolymer_feature",
    #     description="Homopolymer run-length bin or run-base identity",
    # ),
    # ParameterCategory(
    #     key="latent_state",
    #     label="Latent state",
    #     column="latent_state",
    #     description="Hidden Markov model latent state index",
    # ),
]
```

## Data Loading

```{python}
#| echo: false
def load_artifact(path) -> dict:
    """Load a torch model artifact across PyTorch versions."""
    try:
        return torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
    except TypeError:
        return torch.load(path, map_location="cpu")


def get_model_id(artifact: dict) -> str:
    """Return model identifier, handling both old and new artifact formats."""
    return str(artifact.get("model_id") or artifact.get("model", "unknown"))


def get_model_type(artifact: dict) -> str:
    """Return model type string, handling both old and new artifact formats."""
    raw = artifact.get("model_type") or artifact.get("parameterization", "combinatorial_context")
    # Normalise legacy values
    if raw in ("full_context", "context"):
        return "combinatorial_context"
    return str(raw)


aic_path = RESULTS_DIR / "context_model_aic.csv"
if not aic_path.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"Missing comparison CSV: {aic_path}")

comparison = pd.read_csv(aic_path)

# ── Backward-compat: ensure model_id / model_type columns exist ───────────────
if "model_id" not in comparison.columns:
    comparison["model_id"] = comparison.get("model", pd.Series(dtype=str))
if "model_type" not in comparison.columns:
    _pmap = {
        "additive_context":    "additive_context",
        "full_context":        "combinatorial_context",
        "context":             "combinatorial_context",
    }
    comparison["model_type"] = comparison.get(
        "parameterization", pd.Series(dtype=str)
    ).map(_pmap).fillna("combinatorial_context")

_numeric_cols = [
    "context_length", "n_train", "n_test",
    "train_log_likelihood", "test_log_likelihood",
    "train_elbo", "test_elbo",
    "num_parameters", "aic", "low_count_contexts", "prior_scale",
]
for _col in _numeric_cols:
    if _col in comparison.columns:
        comparison[_col] = pd.to_numeric(comparison[_col], errors="coerce")

# ── Load artifacts ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
artifact_paths = sorted(RESULTS_DIR.glob(ARTIFACT_GLOB))
if not artifact_paths:
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"No context model artifacts matching '{ARTIFACT_GLOB}' in {RESULTS_DIR}")

_raw_artifacts = {path.stem: load_artifact(path) for path in artifact_paths}
print(f"Loaded {len(_raw_artifacts)} artifacts from {RESULTS_DIR.resolve()}")

# ── Platform filtering ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if PLATFORM != "all":
    artifacts = {k: v for k, v in _raw_artifacts.items() if v.get("platform") == PLATFORM}
    comparison = comparison[comparison["platform"] == PLATFORM].copy()
    print(f"Filtered to platform '{PLATFORM}': {len(artifacts)} artifacts")
else:
    artifacts = _raw_artifacts

# ── Align comparison CSV to loaded artifacts ───────────────────────────────────
_artifact_keys = {
    (get_model_id(a), a.get("platform", ""))
    for a in artifacts.values()
}
comparison = comparison[
    comparison.apply(
        lambda r: (str(r["model_id"]), str(r["platform"])) in _artifact_keys,
        axis=1,
    )
].copy()
comparison.head(3)
```

```{python}
perf = comparison.copy()
perf["train_nll_per_base"] = -perf["train_log_likelihood"] / perf["n_train"]
perf["test_nll_per_base"] = -perf["test_log_likelihood"] / perf["n_test"]
perf["test_perplexity"] = np.exp(perf["test_nll_per_base"])

mle = perf[perf["inference"] == "maximum_likelihood"].copy()
if not mle.empty:
    mle["delta_aic"] = mle.groupby("platform")["aic"].transform(lambda x: x - x.min())
    mle["aic_ratio_to_min"] = mle.groupby("platform")["aic"].transform(
        lambda x: x / x.min()
    )
    mle["akaike_weight"] = mle.groupby("platform")["delta_aic"].transform(
        lambda x: np.exp(-0.5 * x) / np.exp(-0.5 * x).sum()
    )

vi = perf[perf["inference"] == "variational_inference"].copy()
if not vi.empty:
    vi["test_elbo_per_base"] = vi["test_elbo"] / vi["n_test"]
```

## Parameter Extraction

```{python}
#| echo: false
def _base_labels_for_params(params: dict, context_length: int) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    if "base_logits" in params:
        return LEGACY_BASES[: int(params["base_logits"].shape[1])]
    if "logits" in params:
        count = int(params["logits"].reshape(-1, len(ERROR_LABELS)).shape[0])
        for bases in (DEFAULT_BASES, LEGACY_BASES):
            if count == len(bases) ** context_length:
                return bases
    return DEFAULT_BASES


def _decode_context(index: int, context_length: int, base_labels: tuple) -> str:
    parts = []
    cur = int(index)
    for _ in range(context_length):
        parts.append(base_labels[cur % len(base_labels)])
        cur //= len(base_labels)
    return "".join(reversed(parts))


def _context_base_matrix(context_length: int, base_count: int, indices: np.ndarray | None = None) -> np.ndarray:
    if indices is None:
        indices = np.arange(base_count ** context_length)
    cols = []
    for pos in range(context_length):
        div = base_count ** (context_length - pos - 1)
        cols.append((indices // div) % base_count)
    return np.stack(cols, axis=1)


def _compose_logits(params: dict, context_length: int, ctx_indices: np.ndarray | None = None) -> np.ndarray:
    if "logits" in params:
        logits = params["logits"].detach().cpu().numpy().reshape(-1, len(ERROR_LABELS))
        return logits if ctx_indices is None else logits[ctx_indices]
    intercept = params["intercept_logits"].detach().cpu().numpy()
    base_logits = params["base_logits"].detach().cpu().numpy()
    base_logits = base_logits - base_logits.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    bm = _context_base_matrix(context_length, base_logits.shape[1], ctx_indices)
    logits = np.broadcast_to(intercept, (bm.shape[0], len(ERROR_LABELS))).copy()
    for pos in range(context_length):
        logits += base_logits[pos, bm[:, pos], :]
    return logits


def _compose_logit_sd(stdevs: dict, context_length: int, ctx_indices: np.ndarray | None = None) -> np.ndarray:
    if "logits" in stdevs:
        sd = stdevs["logits"].detach().cpu().numpy().reshape(-1, len(ERROR_LABELS))
        return sd if ctx_indices is None else sd[ctx_indices]
    intercept_var = np.square(stdevs["intercept_logits"].detach().cpu().numpy())
    base_sd = stdevs["base_logits"].detach().cpu().numpy()
    bm = _context_base_matrix(context_length, base_sd.shape[1], ctx_indices)
    var = np.broadcast_to(intercept_var, (bm.shape[0], len(ERROR_LABELS))).copy()
    for pos in range(context_length):
        var += np.square(base_sd[pos, bm[:, pos], :])
    return np.sqrt(np.maximum(var, 0))


def _center(logits: np.ndarray, sd: np.ndarray | None = None):
    c = logits - logits.mean(axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    if sd is None:
        return c, None
    n = sd.shape[-1]
    var = np.square(sd)
    cvar = var * (1 - 2 / n) + var.sum(axis=-1, keepdims=True) / n ** 2
    return c, np.sqrt(np.maximum(cvar, 0))


def _softmax(x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    s = x - x.max(axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    e = np.exp(s)
    return e / e.sum(axis=-1, keepdims=True)


def _derive_category_columns(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Add error_type_group and nearest_base; leave context_distance as NA."""
    df = df.copy()
    if "error_type" in df.columns:
        df["error_type_group"] = df["error_type"].map(_ERROR_GROUP).fillna("other")
    if "context" in df.columns:
        df["nearest_base"] = df["context"].str[-1:].where(df["context"].str.len() > 0, other=pd.NA)
    if "context_distance" not in df.columns:
        df["context_distance"] = pd.NA
    if "context_base" not in df.columns:
        df["context_base"] = pd.NA
    return df


def extract_composed_params(name: str, artifact: dict, max_contexts: int = 50_000) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Return per-(context, error_type) VI parameter rows from one artifact.

    When 4^context_length exceeds max_contexts, a random sample of context
    indices is drawn so that arrays of that size are never materialised.
    """
    context_length = int(artifact.get("context_length", 0))
    vi = artifact.get("variational_inference", {})
    means = vi.get("params_mean", {})
    stdevs = vi.get("params_stdev", {})

    has_mean = "logits" in means or "intercept_logits" in means
    has_sd = "logits" in stdevs or "intercept_logits" in stdevs
    if not has_mean or not has_sd:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    base_labels = _base_labels_for_params(means, context_length)
    n_ctx_total = len(base_labels) ** context_length

    if n_ctx_total > max_contexts:
        ctx_indices = np.sort(np.random.default_rng(42).choice(n_ctx_total, size=max_contexts, replace=False))
    else:
        ctx_indices = None  # use all

    mean_logits = _compose_logits(means, context_length, ctx_indices)
    sd_logits = _compose_logit_sd(stdevs, context_length, ctx_indices)
    c_mean, c_sd = _center(mean_logits, sd_logits)
    probs = _softmax(mean_logits)

    n_ctx, n_err = c_mean.shape
    # Vectorised z / p-value computation — avoids a Python loop over 4^N × E rows
    z = np.where(c_sd > 0, c_mean / c_sd, np.nan)
    p = np.where(np.isfinite(z), 2.0 * stats.norm.sf(np.abs(z)), np.nan)
    mlp = np.where(p > 0, -np.log10(p), np.nan)

    ctx_iter = ctx_indices if ctx_indices is not None else range(n_ctx_total)
    ctx_strs = [_decode_context(int(i), context_length, base_labels) for i in ctx_iter]
    df = pd.DataFrame({
        "artifact":            name,
        "platform":            artifact.get("platform", ""),
        "model_id":            get_model_id(artifact),
        "model_type":          get_model_type(artifact),
        "context_length":      context_length,
        "context_index":       np.repeat(np.arange(n_ctx), n_err),
        "context":             np.repeat(ctx_strs, n_err),
        "error_type":          np.tile(list(ERROR_LABELS), n_ctx),
        "centered_logit_mean": c_mean.ravel(),
        "centered_logit_sd":   c_sd.ravel(),
        "ci_low":              (c_mean - 1.96 * c_sd).ravel(),
        "ci_high":             (c_mean + 1.96 * c_sd).ravel(),
        "z":                   z.ravel(),
        "p_value":             p.ravel(),
        "minus_log10_p":       mlp.ravel(),
        "probability_mean":    probs.ravel(),
    })
    return _derive_category_columns(df)


def extract_position_params(name: str, artifact: dict) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Return per-(position, base, error_type) parameter rows for additive models.

    Returns an empty DataFrame for any model type that does not expose
    explicit position-level parameters (e.g. full-context or future types
    that store position effects under different key names).
    """
    if get_model_type(artifact) != "additive_context":
        return pd.DataFrame()

    context_length = int(artifact.get("context_length", 0))
    vi = artifact.get("variational_inference", {})
    means = vi.get("params_mean", {})
    stdevs = vi.get("params_stdev", {})

    if "base_logits" not in means or "base_logits" not in stdevs:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    m = means["base_logits"].detach().cpu().numpy()   # [L, B, E]
    s = stdevs["base_logits"].detach().cpu().numpy()  # [L, B, E]
    # Center over bases (same transformation as the model applies at run time)
    c_m = m - m.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    c_s = s  # SD unchanged by the mean-subtraction of the mean

    base_labels = LEGACY_BASES[: m.shape[1]]
    n_pos, n_base, n_err = c_m.shape
    # Vectorised z / p-value computation over all (position, base, error) triples
    z = np.where(c_s > 0, c_m / c_s, np.nan)
    p = np.where(np.isfinite(z), 2.0 * stats.norm.sf(np.abs(z)), np.nan)
    mlp = np.where(p > 0, -np.log10(p), np.nan)

    distances = np.array([context_length - pos for pos in range(n_pos)])  # [L]
    dist_rep  = np.repeat(np.repeat(distances, n_base), n_err)             # [L*B*E]
    base_rep  = np.tile(np.repeat(list(base_labels), n_err), n_pos)       # [L*B*E]
    err_rep   = np.tile(list(ERROR_LABELS), n_pos * n_base)               # [L*B*E]

    df = pd.DataFrame({
        "artifact":        name,
        "platform":        artifact.get("platform", ""),
        "model_id":        get_model_id(artifact),
        "model_type":      "additive_context",
        "context_length":  context_length,
        "context_distance": dist_rep,
        "context_base":    base_rep,
        "error_type":      err_rep,
        "error_type_group": [_ERROR_GROUP.get(e, "other") for e in err_rep],
        "nearest_base":    pd.NA,
        "base_logit_mean": c_m.ravel(),
        "base_logit_sd":   c_s.ravel(),
        "z":               z.ravel(),
        "p_value":         p.ravel(),
        "minus_log10_p":   mlp.ravel(),
    })
    return df


def _resolve_prefix_path(prefix: str | Path) -> Path:
    """Resolve artifact data prefixes relative to the report and results root."""
    path = Path(prefix).expanduser()
    if path.is_absolute():
        return path
    candidates = [
        (RESULTS_DIR.parent / path).resolve(),
        path.resolve(),
    ]
    for candidate in candidates:
        if candidate.with_suffix(".summary_phred.csv").exists():
            return candidate
    return candidates[0]


def load_quality_summary_rows(name: str, artifact: dict) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Return summary_phred rows referenced by one model artifact."""
    rows = []
    prefix_sets = [
        ("train", artifact.get("train_prefixes", [])),
        ("test", artifact.get("test_prefixes", [])),
    ]
    for split, prefixes in prefix_sets:
        for prefix in prefixes:
            resolved = _resolve_prefix_path(prefix)
            path = resolved.with_suffix(".summary_phred.csv")
            if not path.exists():
                continue
            data = pd.read_csv(path)
            required = {"qscore", "num_correct", "num_error", "error_rate"}
            if not required.issubset(data.columns):
                continue
            data = data.copy()
            data["artifact"] = name
            data["platform"] = artifact.get("platform", "")
            data["model_id"] = get_model_id(artifact)
            data["model_type"] = get_model_type(artifact)
            data["split"] = split
            data["source_prefix"] = str(resolved)
            rows.append(data)
    if not rows:
        return pd.DataFrame()
    return pd.concat(rows, ignore_index=True)


# ── Aggregate across all loaded artifacts ──────────────────────────────────────
_composed_chunks = [
    extract_composed_params(name, art)
    for name, art in artifacts.items()
]
composed_params = pd.concat([df for df in _composed_chunks if not df.empty], ignore_index=True)
del _composed_chunks

_position_chunks = [
    extract_position_params(name, art)
    for name, art in artifacts.items()
]
position_params = pd.concat([df for df in _position_chunks if not df.empty], ignore_index=True)
del _position_chunks

_quality_chunks = [
    load_quality_summary_rows(name, art)
    for name, art in artifacts.items()
]
quality_summary = pd.concat(
    [df for df in _quality_chunks if not df.empty],
    ignore_index=True,
) if any(not df.empty for df in _quality_chunks) else pd.DataFrame()
del _quality_chunks

# Free PyTorch tensor memory — all data is now in numpy/pandas
del artifacts, _raw_artifacts
import gc; gc.collect()

print(f"Composed parameter rows: {len(composed_params):,}")
print(f"Position parameter rows:  {len(position_params):,}")
print(f"Quality summary rows:     {len(quality_summary):,}")
```

## Visualisation Helpers

```{python}
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Heatmap and volcano helper functions"
_CLUSTER_ROW_LIMIT = 80  # rows above this fall back to natural order (O(n²) clustering too slow)

def _ward_order(df: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple[list, list]:
    mat = df.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    finite = mat[np.isfinite(mat)]
    fill = float(np.nanmedian(finite)) if finite.size else 0.0
    mat = np.nan_to_num(mat, nan=fill, posinf=fill, neginf=fill)
    if mat.shape[0] > 1 and mat.shape[0] <= _CLUSTER_ROW_LIMIT:
        row_ord = leaves_list(linkage(mat, method="ward")).tolist()
    else:
        row_ord = list(range(mat.shape[0]))  # keep pre-sorted order for large matrices
    col_ord = leaves_list(linkage(mat.T, method="ward")).tolist() if mat.shape[1] > 1 else list(range(mat.shape[1]))
    return [df.index[i] for i in row_ord], [df.columns[i] for i in col_ord]


def _log_heatmap_scale(probs: pd.DataFrame, exclude=("match",)):
    scale = probs.drop(columns=[c for c in exclude if c in probs], errors="ignore")
    pos = scale.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    pos = pos[pos > 0]
    if pos.size == 0:
        zmin, zmax, floor = -12.0, 0.0, -13.0
    else:
        zmin, zmax = float(np.log10(pos.min())), float(np.log10(pos.max()))
        floor = float(np.floor(zmin)) - 1
    log_vals = np.log10(np.clip(probs.to_numpy(dtype=float), 10 ** floor, None))
    return log_vals, zmin, zmax, floor


def make_probability_heatmap(
    subset: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    model_id: str,
    platform: str,
    context_length: int,
    sample_size: int = 500,
    max_contexts: int = 80,
) -> go.Figure | None:
    """Return a log-probability heatmap for a single (model, platform) pair."""
    ctx_vals = subset["context"].drop_duplicates()
    n = min(sample_size, len(ctx_vals))
    ctx_order = ctx_vals.sample(n=n, random_state=42).sort_values().tolist()
    hdf = subset[subset["context"].isin(ctx_order)].pivot(
        index="context", columns="error_type", values="probability_mean"
    )
    # Ensure canonical column order
    hdf = hdf.reindex(columns=[c for c in ERROR_LABELS if c in hdf.columns])
    hdf = hdf.loc[ctx_order]
    if hdf.empty:
        return None

    log_vals, zmin, zmax, _ = _log_heatmap_scale(hdf)
    log_df = pd.DataFrame(log_vals, index=hdf.index, columns=hdf.columns)
    row_ord, col_ord = _ward_order(log_df)
    hdf, log_df = hdf.loc[row_ord, col_ord], log_df.loc[row_ord, col_ord]

    fig = go.Figure(go.Heatmap(
        z=log_df.to_numpy(), x=list(log_df.columns), y=list(log_df.index),
        customdata=hdf.to_numpy(), colorscale="BuPu", zmin=zmin, zmax=zmax,
        colorbar={"title": "log₁₀(p)"},
        hovertemplate="context=%{y}<br>error=%{x}<br>p=%{customdata:.4g}<br>log₁₀(p)=%{z:.3f}<extra></extra>",
    ))
    fig.update_layout(
        template="plotly_white",
        title=f"{platform} / {model_id} — error probabilities (n={len(hdf)} contexts)",
        xaxis_title="Error type", yaxis_title="Context",
        height=max(400, min(1200, 16 * len(hdf))),
    )
    return fig


def make_position_heatmap(
    subset: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    model_id: str,
    platform: str,
) -> go.Figure | None:
    """Return a (distance × base) × error_type heatmap of additive logit effects.

    Each cell is a direct base_logits parameter, with sign preserved and a
    diverging colour scale centred at zero.
    """
    df = subset.copy()
    df["distance_base"] = (
        df["context_distance"].astype(str) + ":" + df["context_base"].astype(str)
    )
    hdf = df.pivot_table(
        index="distance_base", columns="error_type",
        values="base_logit_mean", aggfunc="mean",
    )
    hdf = hdf.reindex(columns=[c for c in ERROR_LABELS if c in hdf.columns])
    # Sort rows: distance descending, then base alphabetically within distance
    hdf = hdf.sort_index(key=lambda idx: pd.MultiIndex.from_tuples(
        [(-int(s.split(":")[0]), s.split(":")[1]) for s in idx]
    ))
    if hdf.empty:
        return None

    vals = hdf.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    abs_max = float(np.nanmax(np.abs(vals)))
    if abs_max == 0:
        abs_max = 1.0

    _, col_ord = _ward_order(pd.DataFrame(vals, index=hdf.index, columns=hdf.columns))
    hdf = hdf[col_ord]

    fig = go.Figure(go.Heatmap(
        z=hdf.to_numpy(), x=list(hdf.columns), y=list(hdf.index),
        colorscale="RdBu", zmid=0, zmin=-abs_max, zmax=abs_max,
        colorbar={"title": "logit effect"},
        hovertemplate=(
            "distance:base=%{y}<br>error=%{x}<br>"
            "logit effect=%{z:.4f}<extra></extra>"
        ),
    ))
    fig.update_layout(
        template="plotly_white",
        title=f"{platform} / {model_id} — additive base effects (distance × base × error)",
        xaxis_title="Error type",
        yaxis_title="Distance : base",
        height=max(360, 28 * len(hdf)),
    )
    return fig


def make_category_volcano(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    x_col: str,
    y_col: str,
    hover_cols: list[str],
    categories: list[ParameterCategory],
    title: str,
    default_category: str | None = None,
    max_points: int = 50_000,
) -> go.Figure | None:
    """Return a Plotly volcano with a dropdown to switch colour category.

    Uses a single data trace whose marker.color is swapped via restyle, plus
    invisible 1-point dummy traces for the legend.  This avoids duplicating
    the (x, y, customdata) arrays once per (category × unique-value) combination,
    which would otherwise multiply HTML size by ~n_traces.

    Categories whose column is absent or fully NA are omitted from the dropdown.
    """
    if df.empty:
        return None

    # Downsample when needed, keeping the most significant points
    if len(df) > max_points:
        n_top = min(len(df), max_points // 5)
        top = df.nsmallest(n_top, "p_value") if "p_value" in df.columns else df.head(n_top)
        rest = df.drop(index=top.index)
        n_rest = max(0, max_points - len(top))
        rest = rest.sample(n=min(n_rest, len(rest)), random_state=42) if n_rest > 0 and not rest.empty else pd.DataFrame()
        df = pd.concat([top, rest], ignore_index=True)

    available = [
        c for c in categories
        if c.column in df.columns and df[c.column].notna().any()
    ]
    if not available:
        return None

    default_idx = next(
        (i for i, c in enumerate(available) if c.key == default_category),
        0,
    )

    ScatterCls = go.Scattergl if len(df) > 5_000 else go.Scatter
    _hcols = [c for c in hover_cols if c in df.columns]
    custom = df[_hcols].values if _hcols else None
    htmpl = (
        "<br>".join(f"{c}=%{{customdata[{i}]}}" for i, c in enumerate(_hcols))
        + "<extra></extra>"
    ) if _hcols else "<extra></extra>"

    # Pre-compute per-category color arrays and unique-value info
    cat_info: list[tuple] = []  # (unique_vals, colormap, color_array_per_point, cat)
    for cat in available:
        vals = df[cat.column].fillna("NA").astype(str)
        unique_vals = sorted(vals.unique())
        colormap = {v: cat.colors[i % len(cat.colors)] for i, v in enumerate(unique_vals)}
        color_array = [colormap[v] for v in vals]
        cat_info.append((unique_vals, colormap, color_array, cat))

    init_unique_vals, init_colormap, init_colors, init_cat = cat_info[default_idx]

    # Trace 0: one data trace — x/y/customdata stored only once
    traces: list = [ScatterCls(
        x=df[x_col], y=df[y_col],
        mode="markers",
        name="",
        marker=dict(color=init_colors, size=4, opacity=0.55),
        customdata=custom,
        hovertemplate=htmpl,
        showlegend=False,
    )]

    # Traces 1+: invisible 1-point dummy traces for the legend
    for cat_i, (unique_vals, colormap, _, cat) in enumerate(cat_info):
        is_default = cat_i == default_idx
        for val in unique_vals:
            traces.append(ScatterCls(
                x=[None], y=[None],
                mode="markers",
                name=val,
                marker=dict(color=colormap[val], size=8),
                visible=is_default,
                showlegend=is_default,
                legendgroup=f"{cat.key}_{val}",
            ))

    fig = go.Figure(data=traces)

    # Dropdown buttons: restyle trace 0's color array + toggle dummy trace visibility.
    # Plotly restyle applies each list element to the trace at that index; providing
    # a list shorter than n_traces updates only those traces and leaves the rest alone.
    # So [color_array] updates only trace 0, while visible/showlegend cover all traces.
    buttons = []
    for cat_i, (unique_vals, colormap, color_array, cat) in enumerate(cat_info):
        visible = [True]  # trace 0 always visible
        showlegend = [False]  # trace 0 never in legend
        for ci, (u_vals, _, _, _) in enumerate(cat_info):
            is_active = ci == cat_i
            visible.extend([is_active] * len(u_vals))
            showlegend.extend([is_active] * len(u_vals))

        buttons.append(dict(
            label=cat.label,
            method="update",
            args=[
                {
                    "marker.color": [color_array],   # updates trace 0 only
                    "visible": visible,
                    "showlegend": showlegend,
                },
                {"title.text": f"{title}<br><sup>Colour: {cat.description}</sup>"},
            ],
        ))

    first_cat = cat_info[default_idx][3]
    fig.update_layout(
        title=f"{title}<br><sup>Colour: {first_cat.description}</sup>",
        xaxis_title=x_col.replace("_", " "),
        yaxis_title="−log₁₀(p)" if "log10_p" in y_col else y_col.replace("_", " "),
        template="plotly_white",
        height=520,
        updatemenus=[dict(
            type="dropdown", direction="down",
            x=0.0, xanchor="left", y=1.16, yanchor="top",
            buttons=buttons, active=default_idx,
            bgcolor="white", bordercolor="#cccccc",
        )],
        annotations=[dict(
            text="<b>Colour by:</b>", x=0.0, xref="paper",
            y=1.19, yref="paper", showarrow=False, font=dict(size=11),
        )],
        legend_title_text=first_cat.label,
    )
    fig.add_vline(x=0, line_color="#333333", line_width=1, line_dash="dot")
    return fig


def rgba(hex_colour: str, alpha: float) -> str:
    hex_colour = hex_colour.lstrip("#")
    red = int(hex_colour[0:2], 16)
    green = int(hex_colour[2:4], 16)
    blue = int(hex_colour[4:6], 16)
    return f"rgba({red},{green},{blue},{alpha})"


def bootstrap_loglinear_curve(
    q_values,
    totals,
    errors,
    q_grid,
    *,
    n_boot: int = 500,
    seed: int = 42,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return parametric-bootstrap 95% bands for a log-linear qcal curve."""
    q_values = np.asarray(q_values, dtype=float)
    totals = np.asarray(totals, dtype=float)
    errors = np.asarray(errors, dtype=float)
    q_grid = np.asarray(q_grid, dtype=float)
    mask = totals > 0
    q_values = q_values[mask]
    totals = totals[mask]
    errors = errors[mask]
    if len(q_values) < 2:
        return np.full_like(q_grid, np.nan, dtype=float), np.full_like(q_grid, np.nan, dtype=float)

    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    p_hat = (errors + 0.5) / (totals + 1.0)
    weights = np.sqrt(totals)
    curves = np.empty((n_boot, len(q_grid)), dtype=float)
    for idx in range(n_boot):
        sampled_errors = rng.binomial(totals.astype(int), p_hat)
        sampled_rate = (sampled_errors + 0.5) / (totals + 1.0)
        slope, intercept = np.polyfit(
            q_values,
            np.log10(np.clip(sampled_rate, 1e-12, 1.0)),
            deg=1,
            w=weights,
        )
        curves[idx] = 10 ** (intercept + slope * q_grid)
    return np.quantile(curves, [0.025, 0.975], axis=0)


def wilson_interval(errors, totals, z: float = 1.96):
    errors = np.asarray(errors, dtype=float)
    totals = np.asarray(totals, dtype=float)
    p = np.divide(errors, totals, out=np.zeros_like(errors), where=totals > 0)
    denom = 1.0 + z**2 / np.maximum(totals, 1.0)
    centre = (p + z**2 / (2.0 * np.maximum(totals, 1.0))) / denom
    half_width = (
        z
        * np.sqrt(
            (p * (1.0 - p) / np.maximum(totals, 1.0))
            + z**2 / (4.0 * np.maximum(totals, 1.0) ** 2)
        )
        / denom
    )
    low = np.where(totals > 0, np.maximum(0.0, centre - half_width), np.nan)
    high = np.where(totals > 0, np.minimum(1.0, centre + half_width), np.nan)
    return low, high


def _quality_curve_tables(summary: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Return empirical quality points and log-linear fit curves with bootstrap bands."""
    if summary.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame(), pd.DataFrame()
    grouped = (
        summary.groupby(["platform", "split", "qscore"], as_index=False)
        .agg(num_correct=("num_correct", "sum"), num_error=("num_error", "sum"))
    )
    grouped["n"] = grouped["num_correct"] + grouped["num_error"]
    grouped["error_rate"] = grouped["num_error"] / grouped["n"]
    low, high = wilson_interval(grouped["num_error"], grouped["n"])
    grouped["ci_low"] = low
    grouped["ci_high"] = high
    grouped["err_plus"] = grouped["ci_high"] - grouped["error_rate"]
    grouped["err_minus"] = grouped["error_rate"] - grouped["ci_low"]

    fit_rows = []
    q_grid = np.arange(int(grouped["qscore"].min()), int(grouped["qscore"].max()) + 1)
    for (platform, split), sub in grouped.groupby(["platform", "split"], sort=False):
        use = sub[(sub["n"] > 0) & (sub["error_rate"] > 0)]
        if len(use) < 2:
            continue
        ci_low, ci_high = bootstrap_loglinear_curve(
            use["qscore"],
            use["n"],
            use["num_error"],
            q_grid,
            seed=42 + sum(ord(char) for char in f"{platform}:{split}"),
        )
        slope, intercept = np.polyfit(
            use["qscore"].astype(float),
            np.log10(use["error_rate"].astype(float)),
            deg=1,
            w=np.sqrt(use["n"].astype(float)),
        )
        for q in q_grid:
            fit_rows.append(
                {
                    "platform": platform,
                    "split": split,
                    "qscore": q,
                    "fitted_error_rate": float(10 ** (intercept + slope * q)),
                    "ci_low": float(ci_low[np.where(q_grid == q)[0][0]]),
                    "ci_high": float(ci_high[np.where(q_grid == q)[0][0]]),
                    "qcal_intercept": float(intercept),
                    "qcal_slope": float(slope),
                }
            )
    return grouped, pd.DataFrame(fit_rows)
```

```{python}
            )
            if _vfig is not None:
```

## P-Value Summary

```{python}
#| label: fig-pvalue-dist
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of p-values for centered logits under a mean-zero null."
#| fig-alt: "Histograms of p-values faceted by model type and model ID."
if composed_params.empty:
    print("No parameter rows available for p-value summary.")
else:
    _bins = np.linspace(0, 1, 41)
    _density_rows = []
    _group_cols = ["platform", "model_id", "model_type"]
    for _key, _sub in composed_params.groupby(_group_cols, sort=False):
        _plt, _mid, _mtype = _key
        _counts, _edges = np.histogram(_sub["p_value"].dropna(), bins=_bins)
        _widths = np.diff(_edges)
        _density = _counts / max(1, _counts.sum()) / _widths
        _centers = _edges[:-1] + _widths / 2
        _density_rows.append(pd.DataFrame({
            "platform": _plt, "model_id": _mid, "model_type": _mtype,
            "p_value_bin": _centers, "density": _density, "count": _counts,
        }))
    _pval_density = pd.concat(_density_rows, ignore_index=True)

    _facet_col = "model_type" if PLATFORM == "all" else None
    _color_col = "platform" if PLATFORM == "all" else "model_id"
    fig = px.bar(
        _pval_density,
        x="p_value_bin", y="density",
        color=_color_col,
        facet_col=_facet_col,
        facet_row="model_type" if PLATFORM != "all" else None,
        facet_row_spacing=0.04,
        hover_data=["count", "model_id", "platform"],
        title="Centered-logit p-values (mean-zero null)",
    )
    fig.update_layout(
        xaxis_title="p-value", yaxis_title="Density",
        template="plotly_white", bargap=0.02,
        height=max(450, 220 * _pval_density["model_type"].nunique()),
    )
    fig.update_yaxes(matches=None)
    fig.for_each_annotation(lambda a: a.update(text=a.text.split("=")[-1]))
    fig.show()
```

## Interpretation Notes

- **Test NLL per base** — lower values indicate better held-out compression of
  the error distribution; the log scale makes small differences at low error
  rates visible.
- **AIC** — penalises model complexity; lower is better.  Additive-context models
  use far fewer parameters than full-context models at the same context length,
  so their AIC curves often intersect at moderate lengths.
- **Parameter volcano** — each point is one (context, error type) parameter.
  Horizontal axis: centered logit mean (positive = more likely than average for
  this context; negative = less likely). Vertical axis: −log₁₀(p) from a
  Wald test against a mean-zero null using the variational posterior SD.
- **Position volcano** — each point is one additive position × base × error
  contribution from an `additive_context` model.  The horizontal axis shows
  the base-level logit centred over nucleotides at that position.
- **Category dropdown** — use the *Colour by* menu on each volcano to switch
  between colourings.  Categories whose column is absent or all-NA for a
  given model are omitted from the menu automatically.
- **Extending to new model types** — add a `ParameterCategory` entry to
  `PARAMETER_CATEGORIES` above and populate the corresponding column in the
  extraction functions (`extract_composed_params`, `extract_position_params`,
  or a new function for structurally different parameter sets such as
  homopolymer run-length slopes or HMM latent-state emission tables).
